cases.expected_relation: identical indoor/outdoor state without sources: no thermal or humidity drift
sealed adiabatic air: stored heat C*dT equals transmitted solar energy (no energy created or lost)
indoor warmer than outdoor loses heat, colder gains heat
without sources the exchange is linear in (T_in - T_out): doubling the difference doubles the change
translating both temperatures (across 20 C) leaves the exchange unchanged: no fixed reference temperature
pure decay with tau = C/G: after ln2*tau the indoor-outdoor difference halves
higher outdoor temperature gives a higher indoor temperature, ceteris paribus
exchanged fraction = 1 - exp(-ACH dt/3600), 0 at 0 ACH, increasing with ACH, never instantaneous equilibrium
more air exchange brings indoor temperature closer to outdoor; no change at 0 ACH
more air exchange brings indoor vapour closer to outdoor; no change at 0 ACH
more air exchange brings indoor co2 closer to outdoor; no change at 0 ACH
air exchange = configured ventilation_ach + actuator ventilation
when ventilation leaves the microclimate unchanged, the crop is unchanged: no actuator-to-biomass path
RH in [0, 100] %, VPD >= 0 kPa, VPD = 0 at saturation, for dry, humid and saturated air
sealed air below saturation: vapour mass gain equals transpired water (1 mm = 1 kg m-2)
cooling humid air caps vapour at saturation: RH = 100 %, VPD = 0
Phase 5.29 regression: no latent heat flux while indoor air is saturated (VPD = 0) in a closed greenhouse
transpiration demand is not VPD-corrected a second time (only the saturation cap), and crop VPD stress is one ramp of the environment VPD
VPD is reported in kPa (Tetens e_s(25 C) = 3.1686 kPa, half of it at 50 % RH)
no canopy: no transpiration and no latent flux
canopy without radiative demand (night): no transpiration, no latent flux
LE = E*lambda/3600 and the greenhouse cools by exactly LE*A*dt/C (single application, correct sign)
saturated air (VPD = 0) has no evaporative capacity: no latent cooling
more evaporative capacity (lower RH) gives non-decreasing latent flux, bounded by the water-balance demand
indoor radiation = outdoor x transmission (lower transmission, less radiation)
indoor radiation = outdoor x transmission x (1 - shading) (more shading, less radiation)
no outdoor radiation: no indoor radiation and no potential growth
potential growth = PAR(indoor radiation) x (1 - exp(-k LAI)) x RUE, applied once; never the outdoor radiation
sealed air: supply adds and uptake removes exactly their per-step increments
with constant supply and exchange, CO2 tends to C_out + S/k
more supply gives higher indoor CO2, ceteris paribus
a growing canopy lowers indoor CO2 relative to the same greenhouse without crop
MicroclimateState.CO2 -> CropGrowthInput.co2_ppm -> CropGrowthEngine.co2_response, applied once in both integration paths; double input rejected
outdoor: crop temperature == outdoor weather temperature (whole WeatherState, rain included)
greenhouse: crop temperature == indoor microclimate temperature, not outdoor
greenhouse: crop RH, VPD, radiation and CO2 are the indoor values and no rain reaches the crop
without crop exchanges (all zero) the loop reproduces the greenhouse step (to 1e-12 relative, the rounding of the relaxation blend)

one iteration = one relaxation of the candidate toward the recomputed state, both from the same start state
intermediate iterations mutate no persistent state: loop and greenhouse backend hold the converged state, the input crop is untouched
combined thermal+latent+CO2 feedback converges every step, replays identically, has no NaN/Inf and no artificial temperature oscillation
the same scenario replayed through SimulationClock gives an identical full trajectory
1 kW for 1 h into C = thermal_mass_kj_k x 1000 J/K raises T by 3.6e6 / C
0.36 mm/h over 1 m2 for 1 h evaporates 0.36 kg (below saturation) and removes its latent heat
benchmark execution mutates neither the ParameterRegistry, nor GreenhouseConfiguration, nor input crop states

energyplus.detail: EnergyPlus executable and pyenergyplus are not available
energyplus.role: optional secondary backend; never ground truth

scientific_limitations: Lumped single-zone well-mixed air; no CFD, no longwave radiative exchange, condensation releases no latent heat to the air.
Default geometry (1000 m3 air with a 1 m2 exchange area) is an engineering placeholder; magnitudes are not calibrated and only directions/closures are benchmarked.
Crop sensible heat is an engineering proxy; transpiration demand is the WaterBalanceEngine Hargreaves-type estimate capped by the indoor vapour deficit.
CO2 response is the existing min(1, CO2/420) engineering response; no enrichment benefit is represented.
Benchmarks are synthetic and analytic; they establish internal physical consistency only, not biological validity or field accuracy.

scientific_status.meaning_of_qualified: the implementation passed the synthetic physical benchmarks of Phase 5.31; not validation against a real greenhouse
